bundle.title: 2026-08-28 Phase 1 catalog behavior and stock-client interoperability

run.sanitized_invocation: optimized Compose conformance matrix (4 scenarios x 5 catalogs), followed by stock PyIceberg matrix (1 scenario x 5 catalogs)

environment.network: catalog-bench-net: one Docker bridge shared by the optimized runner, all catalogs, state stores, and source-built MinIO

redaction.policy: All runners use value-safe transcript contracts: authorization, OAuth tokens, delegated storage credentials, idempotency keys, raw row values, and raw response bodies are omitted or redacted before persistence. The publication scanner independently rejects credential shapes and non-redacted structured secret fields.
removed_fields: OAuth client credentials and bearer tokens
authorization and idempotency request header values
raw row values and raw response bodies
